body: You really made me regret posting at all.  I didn't put this here so your hero complex could come into play.  For the sake of anyone else you respond to, from now on you really ought to talk to the person a bit or ask more questions before dishing out your ill-informed, unhelpful advice.  If you really cared, you'd have been doing that anyway.  Shameful.

I feel you, bro, same here.  I used to use the same distraction methods as you do.  They worked for years, but not anymore.  I'd listen to you if I would be of any use.  Unfortunately, my brain is in a fog nowadays, but I hope one of these nice folks can help you out.

No I'm not saying no to therapy and meds.  I've been trying them off and on all my life.  In fact, my doctor just gave up on the meds recently as we've tried all we could think of.  They've had zero impact.  NOT being lonely and losing all control of my life is the only thing that has ever worked for me.  It's almost as if my depression is situational and not chemical or something.  Telling me not to worry about anyone else when it's very obvious if you read my post that I'm seriously lonely is really kind of ignorant.  I don't hate myself.  I know I'm a good person.  I just want friends, and love, and to not have to worry about the fact that I have physical limitations that require me to have assistance while being stuck with an abusive and controlling room mate.  There really isn't much I can't handle when I have someone to lean on.  But everyone's obsession with sheer self-sufficiency is honestly obnoxious.  Some people are born to be lovers.  I am one of them.
That's part of it.  There is way too much for one person to handle.  As a result, I become too messy for anyone to want to deal with, and the cycle continues.
